state.user_question: How large a file can I upload?

matched_faq.question: What is the maximum file upload size?
matched_faq.canonical_answer: The maximum upload size is 500MB per file. This limit applies to all paid plans; the free plan limit is 50MB.

passages.text: Files up to 100MB can be uploaded on any plan, including paid plans.
To upload a file, click the paperclip icon in the toolbar and select a file from your device.
